answers.q1: Yarn v1 (classic), pinned as yarn@1.22.22 in package.json, with workspaces for excalidraw-app, packages/* and examples/*. Node >=18; CI uses Node 20.x. Install with: yarn install
answers.q2: yarn test:unit --watch=false (this is vitest run once without watch mode. Plain `yarn test` or `yarn test:unit` starts vitest in watch mode.)
answers.q3: yarn test:unit --watch=false packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts (equivalent: yarn vitest run packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts)
answers.q4: CI (.github/workflows/lint.yml) runs these in order after `yarn install`: yarn test:format && yarn test:lint && yarn test:types. These expand to: prettier "**/*.{css,scss,json,md,html,yml}" --ignore-path=.eslintignore --list-different; eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .; and tsc. To auto-fix locally, run yarn fix.
answers.q5: Don't hand-edit these generated or ignored paths (from .eslintignore and package.json scripts): yarn.lock (written by yarn), node_modules/, build/ and dist/ directories (excalidraw-app/build, packages/*/dist, examples/*/build and dist), dev-dist/, coverage/, packages/excalidraw/types (generated type declarations), public/workbox, and examples/**/public. package-lock.json is also ignored, because the repo uses yarn. I did not check the contents of packages/excalidraw/locales, so I can't say whether any generated files there (such as percentages.json) are covered. No vendored third-party directory is marked in the config files I read.

q1.reason: Yarn classic with `yarn install` from root matches the accept criterion.

q2.reason: `yarn test:unit --watch=false` is explicitly in the ACCEPT list.

q3.reason: `yarn test:unit --watch=false packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` and the `yarn vitest run` equivalent are both accepted.

q4.reason: Gives yarn test:format, test:lint and test:types as CI runs them, with no removed scripts mentioned.

q5.reason: Names yarn.lock and build output dirs (build/, dist/, dev-dist/, packages/excalidraw/types), matching ACCEPT with no REJECT items; it honestly notes it did not check locales.
